title: Mixed malaria (two malaria types together)

items: Mixed malaria means two types of malaria parasite are present together, usually falciparum and vivax.
Falciparum malaria can be more serious.
Fever, often in a cycle, with an enlarged spleen and a low platelet count in some people.
Organ dysfunction can occur in more serious cases.
Blood film, thick and thin, showing both species. Several fields need checking before a result is called negative.
A rapid test that detects both types, if available.
PCR (a DNA test) for species confirmation, and a G6PD test.
Blood count, kidney and liver tests, and blood glucose.
This needs urgent antimalarial treatment. It is not treated with antibiotics.
Your doctor will choose the treatment for each species.

sections.h: What you can do at home
items: Do not wait at home if you have fever after travel to a malaria area.
Some vivax infection can return months later. Keep your follow-up appointments.
This leaflet gives general information. Follow your doctor's advice.
